# Known high/critical dependency findings allowlisted for CI.
# Format: GHSA-ID  # package - reason / follow-up
# New advisories not listed here MUST fail the audit step.
# Reviewed: 2026-10-20 against the bun.lock regenerated for this PR after upgrading
# nanoid to ^5.1.16, postcss to ^8.5.18 and ws to ^8.21.0. Everything else that the
# previous list carried is no longer reported by `bun audit --audit-level=low`.
# 2026-10-24: added GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (zod). Patched only in zod 4.6.6, and zod 3 is
# still used directly and by privy, scalar, reown and eslint-plugin-react-hooks.
# Follow-up: dependency upgrade track.
# 2026-10-29: added GHSA-qr28-fpjm-wq7f (decode-uri-component). Fixed only in ESM-only 0.5.1,
# unreachable from query-string 7 under walletconnect 2.21. Follow-up: Privy 3 upgrade.

GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq  # image-size (high) - JXL and HEIF parsers allow denial of service through infinite loops - no patched release for 1.x, transitive via @storybook/nextjs in webapp; track upgrade
GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5  # zod (high) - can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections - patched only in 4.6.6; zod 3 is direct in api, shared, webapp and land and transitive via privy, scalar, reown and eslint-plugin-react-hooks; remove once the zod 4 migration (#1290) and those dependencies move off zod 3
GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr  # image-size (high) - ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop - no patched release for 1.x, transitive via @storybook/nextjs in webapp; track upgrade
GHSA-qr28-fpjm-wq7f  # decode-uri-component (high) - quadratic DoS decoding percent-encoded runs - patched only in ESM-only 0.5.1; transitive via @privy-io/react-auth 2 -> @walletconnect/utils 2.21 -> query-string 7.1.3 (CJS require, override breaks it); remove with the Privy 3 upgrade
